lines.zh: 我拖着黄金薙刀走，刃尖刮地。
lines.en: I drag my golden naginata; its tip scrapes.

lines.zh: 圣袍在我身后拖得很长。
lines.en: My holy robe trails long behind me.
I circle once before the altar.
Every step sounds like a verdict.
I walk. My path is a straight line.
I watch the ground, not people.
The prayer book swings at my hip.

lines.zh: 我慢慢踱到圣坛另一侧。
lines.en: I pace to the altar's far side.

lines.zh: 这座殿堂回响着我的脚步。
lines.en: The hall echoes my steps.
My hem sweeps up a layer of dust.
My stride is steadier than the bell.

lines.zh: 穿这身衣服走路，得端着。
lines.en: In these robes, one must walk with care.
I reach the door and turn back.
Eyes low, naginata in hand, I stand.
Three bell tolls. I listen.
The hall is cold; my robe is heavy.
I still recite the old doctrine.

lines.zh: 我在等第一阶段的结束。
lines.en: I wait for the first stage to end.
This body is the second form.

lines.zh: 烛火摇了摇，我知道风向。
lines.en: The candle sways. I know the wind.

lines.zh: 圣座不需要休息，只等待。
lines.en: The throne does not rest. It waits.
I count cracks in the stained glass.
Gold ages. The word does not.
I turn my naginata a quarter.
The hall is empty. Good for prayer.

lines.zh: 我闭眼，钟声在骨头里响。
lines.en: I close my eyes; the bell rings in my bones.

lines.zh: 我的呼吸和烛焰一个节奏。
lines.en: My breath matches the candle's flicker.
No one comes. I keep standing.
You entered the sanctum. Kneel.
After the first stage, I am next.
I need not count your sins.
Look at this golden naginata.
I know the way you walk.
Do not call me king. I am not.
What do you seek? Say it.
Closer, so I may see you plainly.
This hall admits one kind of person.

lines.zh: 你手里的武器，握得太紧。
lines.en: You grip that weapon too hard.

lines.zh: 我见过许多来祈祷的人。
lines.en: I have seen many come to pray.
Do not look directly at my face.
Your footsteps are too loud.

lines.zh: 教宗的黄金薙刀，别抬头。
lines.en: The pontiff's golden naginata. Don't look up.
I have waited long enough.
Look up. Look at this blade.
A slit opens in my robe.
Pain will not change the verdict.
A few threads of old cloth come loose.
I grip my naginata and steady myself.
Bleeding does not stop prayer.
I step back. Still standing.
You dared to strike the throne.
I write this in the ledger.

lines.zh: 黄金不会因这点伤变形。
lines.en: Gold does not warp from this.
I reset my breath and raise the blade.
Offerings go at the foot of the steps.
Gold? I have enough.
This old cloth. I know it.
Eating in the sanctum?
Set it down, then take three steps back.
I take no mortal rations.
Your offering is held wrongly.
Holy things should not be greasy.
You are sincere. I see it.
Relic gold. I accept it.

lines.zh: 把供品举过头顶，我才会看。
lines.en: Raise the offering overhead; then I look.

lines.zh: 台阶脏了，先擦干净再放。
lines.en: The step is dirty. Wipe it, then place.

lines.zh: 我接过来，替你转呈上去。
lines.en: I take it and pass it upward for you.
Touching the throne is trespass.
You struck my naginata's shaft.
Back. There is no crowding here.
You stand on my robe.
One step more is sin.
A bump will not alter judgment.
You are shorter; you hit my hem.
Make way. I go to the altar.
You hit my golden robe and stagger back three steps.
Do not use hands. It burns.
The throne does not discuss that.

lines.zh: 我这一身，是旧布料缝的。
lines.en: This body is stitched from old cloth.
Faith needs no bloodline.

lines.zh: 我只有一场仪式要完成。
lines.en: I have one rite to finish.

lines.zh: 问这个，你会被逐出殿堂。
lines.en: Ask that and be cast out.
Only echoes live in this hall.

lines.zh: 我不是生出来的，是被造出来的。
lines.en: I was made, not born.
Gold does not pair.
Silence. Kneel. Pray.

lines.zh: 这个问题，不配得到回答。
lines.en: That question deserves no answer.
I gather up this old cloth.
Relic gold belongs to the sanctum.
I pick up the fallen prayer beads.
Nothing mortal may lie on this floor.
Your sword goes below the steps.
I bend, and my hem spreads.
This bears blood. It must be washed.
I pick up my naginata and grip it.
Keep it. Do not drop it here again.

lines.zh: 我拾起一片碎金，收进袖。
lines.en: I slip a shard of gold into my sleeve.
Judgment begins. Hold your ground.
I raise the blade. You should retreat.

lines.zh: 这是第二阶段，不是试炼。
lines.en: This is the second stage, not a trial.
You are entered in the ledger of sins.
The bell has stopped. Now.
I mark your chest as the target.
No time left to pray.
The word is given. None are spared.
I step in, blade level.

lines.zh: 你身上的罪，我替你清算。
lines.en: I will settle your sins for you.
I wait for your first swing.

lines.zh: 你的呼吸乱了，审判将至。
lines.en: Your breath breaks. Judgment nears.
My naginata sweeps; you fall back twice.

lines.zh: 殿堂的地砖在为我让路。
lines.en: The tiles seem to part for me.

lines.zh: 你每退一步，钟就响一声。
lines.en: Each step you yield, the bell tolls.
Your shield will not stop this blade.
I watch you without blinking.
At this range, one sweep reaches.
Turn if you like. There is no back door.
I advance slowly. No haste.

lines.zh: 薙刀横扫，血溅在彩窗上。
lines.en: The naginata sweeps; blood hits the glass.
This blade finds you guilty.
I hurl it out and draw it back.
The tip splits your armor.
Kneel. This is the final warning.
Not fast, but exact.
Gold passes with a light sound.

lines.zh: 你挡住了，第二刃在路上。
lines.en: You blocked. The second comes.

lines.zh: 这一击，为第一阶段的你。
lines.en: This is for who you were before.

lines.zh: 殿堂的地面需要清洗了。
lines.en: This floor will need washing.

lines.zh: 第一阶段结束了，我来了。
lines.en: The first stage ends. I arrive.

lines.zh: 彩窗碎了一角，光落下来。
lines.en: A pane breaks; light falls through.

lines.zh: 我从祭坛的阴影里站起。
lines.en: I rise from the altar's shadow.
The bell tolls for the ninth time.
Old cloth stitches together. I open my eyes.
The doors close by themselves.
The golden naginata drops onto stone.
The second form begins.
All candles die. Only my light remains.
The throne is set. The rite continues.
My holy robe catches and chars.
I fall from the altar steps.

lines.zh: 水漫进殿堂，灌满我的袖。
lines.en: Water floods the hall and fills my sleeves.

lines.zh: 爆炸震碎了彩窗，玻璃落我一身。
lines.en: The blast shatters glass onto me.
An arrow sticks in my shoulder. I leave it.
Dark magic tries to silence the word.

lines.zh: 我早已不进食，只是虚弱。
lines.en: I do not eat. I only weaken.

lines.zh: 落雷击穿屋顶，劈在圣座上。
lines.en: Lightning pierces the roof onto the throne.

lines.zh: 殿基裂开，虚空在下面等着。
lines.en: The floor splits; the void waits below.
